Two five-digit numbers are formed using different digits from 0 to 9. Both numbers have some digits missing, as shown below:
Number 1: _ 1 _ 9 _
Number 2: _ 4 _ 6 _
No two consecutive digits of the number series are present in the same number. What is the maximum possible difference of the numbers formed?
a) 47525
b) 52663
c) 52429
d) 46733
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Slicer
break it into small parts
List the six digits not used yet. Which of them can go in Number 1 without sitting next to 1 or 9 in counting order?
Roots
ask why it works
Ask why the order matters: to get the biggest difference, which number should be as large as possible?
YOUR TURN
Make one number as big as you can and the other as small. Subtract.

A, B, C, D, and E each have a different number card among one hundred, one thousand, ten thousand, one lakh, and ten lakhs.
• C has an even number of zeros in his number
• A’s number has 2 zeros less than C’s number
• D’s number has 4 zeros more than A’s number
• The number of zeros in B is more than that of A but less than C
Which number card does E have?
a) One thousand
b) Ten thousand
c) One lakh
d) Ten lakh
My answer
Dyna Thinking Coach
Translator
turn words into numbers, pictures or steps
Turn each card into a count of zeros: hundred 2, thousand 3, ten thousand 4, lakh 5, ten lakh 6.
Echo
say it in your own words
Say it in your own words: "A and D are 4 zeros apart, and C sits 2 zeros above A." Which cards fit?
YOUR TURN
Place C and B, then find the card that is left.
